title: Plugin frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter at the top of content/plugins/<id>/tutorial.md.

id.description: Unique plugin id, must equal the directory name (lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; must start with a letter or digit).

name.description: Display name shown in the UI.

description.description: One-sentence description of what the plugin does.

category.description: Sidebar category bucket (e.g. "基础工具"). Unknown categories auto-create new sidebar buttons.

sections.description: Optional explicit tab configuration. If omitted, sections are derived from .md files in the plugin folder (tutorial.md renders as markdown; the rest render as code blocks).
